desc: In the past, the Browning Citori Field was the standard by which all other over and unders were judged. The Citori 725 is the evolution of that legendary shotgun, now with the modern performance advantage of a low-profile receiver. The Citori 725 receiver is significantly lower than other Citori 12 gauge receivers, yet the Citori 725 shares the renowned durability of generations of Citori over and unders with the same rugged full-width hinge pin and tapered locking bolt design. With a Citori 725, you get the "one with the gun" feeling you want, with the long-lasting durability you expect from a Browning over and under – and the features don't stop there. The Citori 725 showcases a FireLite Mechanical Trigger with unmatched feel and lighter pull weights than ever before. The Inflex Technology recoil pad has also been added to make shooting more comfortable. Experience the benefits these improvements can do for your shooting with a Citori 725 Field.
